# How to contribute to BenBot

Thank you for your interest in contributing to BenBot!

All contributions should be made via opening pull requests in this repository. 
Ensure the PR description clearly describes the fix, feature, or change, and the PR title should adhere to our [git commit message guidelines](https://github.com/benthevining/BenBot/blob/main/config/.gitlint) (conventional commits).

Ensure that all [pre-commit hooks](https://github.com/benthevining/BenBot/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml) pass before committing to your PR branch. Once all CI jobs pass, your PR will be reviewed and merged.

Before writing a PR, please review our [coding standards](https://github.com/benthevining/BenBot/blob/main/docs/CodeStyle.md).
